basic_info.description: VACANT as of 8.31.2025......Step into the charm of old-world San Francisco in this delightful studio condo, nestled within a stunning 1920s Mediterranean-style building in the heart of Russian Hill this historic 15-unit building exudes architectural elegance with a picturesque courtyard fountain and period details throughout.  Inside, the spacious living area is anchored by a wood and gas-burning fireplace, built-in bookshelves, and a grand picture window overlooking lush greenery. The well-appointed kitchen features custom-stained cabinetry, while the thoughtful layout includes a tucked-away bedroom nook for added privacy. Hardwood floors enhance the warmth and character of the space.    Residents enjoy deeded storage, a shared laundry room with stunning Coit Tower views, and an unbeatable location just blocks from North Beach, Aquatic Park, Hyde & Polk Street shops, and the iconic Lombard Street. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, investor or seeking the perfect pied-a-terre, this exceptional home invites you to experience classic San Francisco charm.   Currently tenant-occupied at $2,195/month.  Shown by private appointment only with a minimum of 24HR Notice.
